title: schoenus krausei
intro: Schoenus krausei, commonly known as the Swamp Rice-flower, is a type of plant species in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is native to Australia and is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Schoenus krausei include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
